description: The Markdown engine may be constructed with a base syntax highlighter that emits a recognizable sentinel string for any code block it handles. The slide-extension hook installs its own highlighter that supersedes the base one only while slide mode is active, producing slide highlight markup. These boundary scenarios vary the fenced-code language and exercise slide mode with the base highlighter present in both modes and slide mode active without the base highlighter. The input supplies the Markdown source with a fenced code block, optionally requests the base highlighter, and probes the base-sentinel and slide highlight markers.
